observations: Two black PlayStation 4 consoles are shown, stacked vertically.
The front of the top console shows a PlayStation logo and a textured surface with visible scratches and scuffs.
The side of the top console has a vertical seam and a small label or sticker near the bottom edge.
The consoles are placed on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' and 'No 1 Online Gadget Store' printed on it.
The background shows shelves with boxed electronics, including smartphones and accessories.
No controllers, power cables, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims 'one controller Pad' is included, but none is shown.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
No controller is visible in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or system menu.

risks.risk: Controller is not included or is damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the controller showing its condition and any damage or missing parts.

risks.risk: Console may be a lower-tier model (e.g., PS4 Slim) instead of PS4 Pro
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console's model label or serial number, or a photo showing the console's ports and design to confirm PS4 Pro features.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label or serial number on the console to confirm it is a PS4 Pro.
Video of the console powering on and running a game or system menu.
Photo of the included controller showing its condition.
Photo of the console's ports and design to confirm PS4 Pro features.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
